easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Servo on the battlefield.
Repeat.
